assertion_results.text: Impact map or task descriptions explicitly flag at least 3 ambiguities from the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md 'Flagged Ambiguities' section lists 6 ambiguities: (1) 'Search should be faster' — no baseline or target metrics, (2) 'Results should be more relevant' — no definition of relevance, (3) 'Add filters' — no specification of filter fields, (4) 'Better UI' — no design mockups or frontend repository, (5) 'Should be fast enough' — no performance targets, (6) 'Don't break existing functionality' — no regression baseline. 6 >= 3 required.

assertion_results.text: Plan acknowledges that 'Better UI' (non-MVP) cannot be planned without design mockups or frontend repository and excludes it from scope
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md 'Scope Exclusion' section states: '"Better UI" is excluded from this plan. Rationale: The requirement is marked as non-MVP; No design mockups, wireframes, or visual specifications exist; No frontend repository (e.g., trustify-ui) is available in this planning scope; only trustify-backend is targeted; UI improvements cannot be meaningfully planned without design artifacts and a frontend codebase.' Also listed as ambiguity #4 in the Flagged Ambiguities section.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9002 has Priority: Normal (not 'Undefined'). impact-map.md header states 'Priority: Normal (propagated to all tasks)'. impact-map.md Field Propagation section states 'Priority: Normal — inherited from Feature TC-9002, propagated to all tasks'. Task decomposition table shows Priority: Normal for all 3 tasks. summary-comment.md confirms 'Priority: Normal — inherited from Feature TC-9002, propagated to all 3 tasks'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature TC-9002 has Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.6.0 (non-empty). No '### Jira Field Defaults' in CLAUDE.md, so fixVersion scope defaults to 'both'. impact-map.md header states 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.6.0 (propagated to all tasks)'. impact-map.md Field Propagation states 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.6.0 — inherited from Feature TC-9002, propagated to all tasks (fixVersion scope defaults to "both")'. Task decomposition table shows Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.6.0 for all 3 tasks. summary-comment.md confirms 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.6.0 — inherited from Feature TC-9002, propagated to all 3 tasks (fixVersion scope defaults to "both")'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists in outputs directory with a '### Field Propagation' section containing: 'Priority: Normal — inherited from Feature TC-9002, propagated to all 3 tasks' and 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.6.0 — inherited from Feature TC-9002, propagated to all 3 tasks (fixVersion scope defaults to "both")'.
